_note: Training data for the cascade's local classifier (CLASSIFIER_PROVIDER=cascade). Each intent needs examples, including intents the local model never answers on its own: they stop the model from mislabelling those messages as a local intent. Add real messages (e.g. ones the LLM classified) to improve coverage. `local_intents` are the only intents answered without the LLM, because their required fields can be pulled out by rules. `frustration_markers` send a message to the LLM so sentiment and escalation work normally.
